title: sshoosh belongs on your radar
description:
If your stack is getting messy, puemos/sshoosh is worth a look. Tiny self-hosted SSH/TUI workspace chat for small teams and operators who want real-time collaboration over SSH. It has about 87 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/puemos/sshoosh
